# 🛠️ Maintenance Checklist

## Weekly
- [ ] Review CI failures and open high-priority issues
- [ ] Review dependency/security alerts
- [ ] Check recent deployments and static-host availability
- [ ] Review broken links and documentation drift

## Monthly
- [ ] Review dependency updates and lockfile changes
- [ ] Inspect large assets and build output
- [ ] Run accessibility spot checks on core routes
- [ ] Review remote font/image dependencies
- [ ] Update known limitations and roadmap
- [ ] Confirm repository workflows still use least-privilege permissions

## Before a major release
- [ ] Review threat model and privacy inventory
- [ ] Complete accessibility audit for changed journeys
- [ ] Run full lint/build and available tests
- [ ] Validate static-host SPA fallback
- [ ] Prepare deployment and rollback records
- [ ] Review legal copy against actual data processing
- [ ] Confirm ownership and support escalation
